name: Neo Swiss Billboard
tagline: White page, hairline rules, cobalt-blue billboard numerals in tight heavy Inter with Geist Mono labels. (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: pure white with ink-black type and one cobalt-blue accent for the hero number

typography.style: oversized black-weight sans numerals + mono caps labels + hairline grid

best_for: Heavy results where one headline number must dominate and four supporting metrics sit in a ruled strip. Good for quarterly reviews and impact reports.
avoid_for: Playful or emotional storytelling with photos.
